name: Wooden crate
notes: A plank crate, the grey-box slice's breakable (mw-e03.11, mw-e01.1). Its hit points are its wood's (100); blunt resisted 20%, slash 40%, pierce 80% (arrows stick in it), a shove 50%: two or three heavy blows open it, and it spills what it holds. Four 0.25 m plank chunks; a crate cracking open is about 72 dB at 1 m.
